name: trio_inset_key
desc: Clean this rough into finished pixel art without changing the layout: a sticky sandwich lying sideways. The pink goo crocodile on top hugs the small black witch cat from above; the huge pink goo Doberman lies underneath on its back and wraps both thick arms up around the cat and around the crocodile's back, squeezing the cat between their chests. All three are glued together with thick, stretchy pink goo strands and dripping paint; the cat is squashed in the middle, struggling, eyes squeezed shut. Keep both monsters' designs, colors, yellow marble streaks, and the cat's design. Transparent background.
